DocVecWizard Fixture Document

This is a plain text sample used for automated testing of the offline
document processing pipeline. It contains multiple sentences that are
long enough to exercise the chunker. The chunker splits text into
overlapping segments so that no meaning is lost at the boundary between
two adjacent chunks. Umlauts and special characters are included: ä ö ü
ß Ä Ö Ü. Unicode symbols such as €, ©, and emoji 🚀 are also supported.

The pipeline ingests a document, converts it to normalized text, splits
it into chunks, embeds each chunk with a Qwen3 model, and stores the
resulting vectors in Milvus for later semantic search.
